fix before you deploy:
  functions.api.events[0].authorizer: the authorizer is one of the http api now: it gets the event of payload 2.0, with identitySource and routeArn in place of authorizationToken and methodArn, and returns { isAuthorized, context } in place of an iam policy
  functions.api.events[2].authorizer: the authorizer is one of the http api now: it gets the event of payload 2.0, with identitySource and routeArn in place of authorizationToken and methodArn, and returns { isAuthorized, context } in place of an iam policy
  functions.api.events[3].authorizer: the authorizer is one of the http api now: it gets the event of payload 2.0, with identitySource and routeArn in place of authorizationToken and methodArn, and returns { isAuthorized, context } in place of an iam policy
  functions.api.events[4].authorizer: the authorizer is one of the http api now: it gets the event of payload 2.0, with identitySource and routeArn in place of authorizationToken and methodArn, and returns { isAuthorized, context } in place of an iam policy
  functions.api.events[7].authorizer: set audience to the ids of the user pool's app clients: the http api takes a token only when its aud or client_id is one of them, where the rest api took one of any client of the pool
  functions.api.events[8].authorizer: the route is open now, as a jwt authorizer takes the issuer of a user pool as a string, https://cognito-idp.<region>.amazonaws.com/<pool id>, not a ref: give it an authorizer of http.authorizers, or iam = true
  functions.api.events[9].authorizer: the route is open now, as it names an authorizer of the rest api by its id, which the http api cannot use: give it an authorizer of http.authorizers, or iam = true
  functions.api.events[10].authorizer: the route is open now, as a lambda authorizer is a function of the project, and arn:aws:lambda:eu-west-1:123456789012:function:shared-auth is not one: give it an authorizer of http.authorizers, or iam = true
  functions.api.events[11].private: the route is open now, as it took only requests with an api key, which an http api has none of: give it an authorizer of http.authorizers, or iam = true

left out, to write by hand:
  functions.api.events[13].request: the http api checks no parameters or bodies: check them in the function
  functions.api.events[13].cors: an http api has one cors for all its routes: set it in http.cors
  functions.api.events[15]: an http api of koldstart routes to its function alone: it has no mock integration
